substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim A: "the substrate predicts NON-unique vacuum (n_vacuum > 1), i.e. quantum-ergodicity FAILURE"

                    diagonal-convergence property (Thm 6.11), read by HM as the C*-dynamical system
                    having a UNIQUE vacuum state (remark following Thm 6.11).  [paper PDF, SHA-pinned]
      Definition 2: alpha_t = Ad(e^{i t D_K}); the infinite-T Cesaro average projects onto the
                    commutant {e^{i t D_K} : t}' = ⊕_E B(H_E) (finite-dim von Neumann bicommutant).
      Definition 3: D_K = ⊕_{(p,q)} D_{(p,q)} EXACTLY (PROVEN block-diagonality, off-diag < 8.4e-15);
                    [iK_7, D_K] = 0 at ALL tau (PROVEN — Jensen breaks SU(3) -> U(1)_7 exactly).
      Substitute:   every sector projector P_(p,q) commutes with D_K => P_(p,q) is alpha_t-invariant
                    and G_t-fixed; the commutant contains the 90-dim abelian family {P_(p,q)} ⊕-summed,
                    plus the K_7 charge algebra.
      Simplify:     dim_fix >= 90 > 1 (Def 6.10 ergodicity requires dim_fix = 1)
                    => classically NON-ergodic
                    => (Thm 6.11 contrapositive reading) NO density-one diagonal convergence for the
                    sector observables => vacuum state NON-unique.
                    Floor witness: bottom multiplet |lambda|_min = 0.8197411121, m_min = 2 (cache,
                    sector (0,0)) => the invariant-state simplex over the bottom eigenspace has >= 2
                    extremal points under EVERY candidate vacuum convention => n_vacuum >= 2.
      Canonical form: n_vacuum >= 2 AND dim_fix >= 90.
      Direction:    n_vacuum > 1 => NON-unique vacuum => NON-ergodic. PASS direction = NON-ergodic.
      Conclusion:   fabric-scale integrability corroborated at the spectral-triple level.  [justified]
    Claim B: "QE_defect = 1 >> 0.01 for the balanced union projector"
      Definition 1: QE_defect(A, delta) := (1/N) #{ k : |<e_k, A e_k> - NC-int(A)| >= delta }, delta = 1/4.
      Definition 2: P_S = union of sectors with spectral fraction c_S in [0.4, 0.6] (greedy, deterministic).
      Substitute:   sector-purity (Definition 3 above) => <e_k, P_S e_k> in {0, 1} for every k.
      Simplify:     |<e_k,P_S e_k> - c_S| >= min(c_S, 1 - c_S) >= 0.4 > 1/4 for EVERY k => QE_defect = 1.
      Direction:    1 > 0.01 with two-OOM margin. QE (density-one convergence) requires QE_defect -> 0.
      Conclusion:   quantum ergodicity fails with maximal defect; the measured value quantifies it.
    Claim C: "the Weyl-applicability reference dimension is d = 8"
      Definition 1: HM Def 2.3: Tr(e^{-t D^2}) ~ C t^{-d/2}  (t -> 0 asymptotic on the untruncated triple).
      Definition 2: canonical Weyl dimension of the SU(3) fiber: lim_{sigma->0} d_s = 8 (S52; the
                    8-dim group manifold; spectral-geometer G5 report, canonical table).
      Substitute:   log Tr(e^{-t D_K^2}) = log C - (d/2) log t on the bulk window where neither the
                    truncation edge (t below ~1/lambda_max^2) nor the IR gap (t above ~1/lambda_min^2)
                    dominates; guard factors 4 on both ends pin the window.
      Direction:    d_fit ≈ 8 expected; |d_fit - 8| <= 1.5 admits truncation distortion; outside the
                    band the finite truncation cannot certify the HM hypothesis => criterion
                    INAPPLICABLE => INFO (NOT FAIL — applicability is a guard, not the hypothesis).
      Window-pair fixing (phononic-framing §"Same-functional-different-scale fair-comparison" +
      §"Diffusion-window-observable specialization"): the external reference (HM Def 2.3) is a t->0
      asymptotic on the UNTRUNCATED triple; the substrate-side check fixes the SAME functional
      (heat trace Tr e^{-tD^2}) on the pinned INTERMEDIATE window where the truncated trace can
      express the continuum asymptotic — both sides declared, same observable, same window class.
      The deep-UV d_s -> 0 truncation artifact and the sigma -> 0 limit are NOT consumed.

# ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: >
  Fabric-scale integrability corroborated at the spectral-triple level (NON-ergodic, n_vacuum > 1).
  The HM criterion, applied per the paper's own definitions with applicability verified, registers the
  substrate's PROVEN reducibility (Peter-Weyl block structure + [iK_7,D_K]=0 commutant) as
  vacuum-state non-uniqueness; QE_defect and n_vacuum are the registry-feeding quantifications. NOTE
  (honest margin disclosure): the PASS direction is structurally guaranteed by PROVEN block-diagonality
  — this is a corroboration/quantification anchor (same epistemic class as the tau=0 Lai-Teh reduction
  test, W3 item 9), and the falsification weight rides on the quantitative defect, the applicability
  verdict, and the Szego diagnostic, not on the binary direction.
FAIL_meaning: >
  Uniquely ergodic (tension with fabric-scale integrability). Structurally near-impossible given
  PROVEN block-diagonality: a FAIL would mean the commutant is trivial on the cache, contradicting
  off-diag < 8.4e-15. Escalation protocol pre-registered: FIRST verify cache integrity (SHA + sector
  reconstruction) and the criterion application; if FAIL survives verification, it contradicts PROVEN
  structure -> S101 priority adjudication (Q1 workshop class), and the fabric-scale integrability
  narration (housekeeping §A row A1) is re-opened.
INFO_meaning: >
  Local Weyl law inapplicable on the finite truncation (HM Definition 2.3 hypothesis not certifiable:
  d_fit out of band or R^2 < 0.98 on the pinned window — dual_prior Track B; Class-8.7-adjacent
  tautology reading documented, no corroboration weight). Sub-paths: (a) global-Weyl fit fails;
  (b) local-Weyl fit for P_S fails while global holds; (c) extraction-limited (both PDF routes fail —
  criterion pin unavailable, never filled from memory); (d) mixed indicators (e.g. QE_defect > 0.01
  but n_vacuum convention-ambiguous after extraction). All sub-paths report the measured numbers as
  diagnostics; no registry action.

effort:

| PASS | INFO | Structural leg corroborated; statistics leg diagnostic-only (sub-path documented) | Synthesis records the asymmetric stack; INFO sub-path (a) seeds an S101 refinement CF (finer symmetry resolution, e.g. weight-multiplet labels) ONLY if the 4-field spec test passes |

| INFO | INFO | Both legs diagnostic-only; the fabric-scale claim rests on its existing anchors (CG(24) ⟨r⟩=0.367, r_pooled=0.422, transit-freeze R_therm=5251.82) | Synthesis records; no registry action |

Every cell respects verdict permanence (`gate-verdicts.md`): verdicts land once; re-examination happens through NEW gates/workshops, never retroactive edits. FAIL and INFO are results, not agent failures (`math-scripts.md §"All Results Are Good Results"`).
